b5b1ccc3b47907bb8bad.en: Use commas to separate the things in a list.
b5b1ccc3b47907bb8bad.id: Pakai koma (comma) untuk memisahkan hal-hal dalam daftar.

8789f1eca63a4845df51.en: Before and, we usually do not need a comma.
8789f1eca63a4845df51.id: Sebelum and, biasanya kita tidak perlu koma.

49412b6a86318133e8ac.en: An apostrophe can show that letters are missing.
49412b6a86318133e8ac.id: Apostrof (apostrophe) bisa menunjukkan bahwa ada huruf yang hilang.

022c84948cb0e4825641.en: Put the apostrophe exactly where the letters were.
022c84948cb0e4825641.id: Letakkan apostrof tepat di tempat huruf yang hilang itu.

33adc2da5eb3d8f36498.en: Its with no apostrophe means belonging to it.

18be45fcc35443aeb33d.en: Isn't is short for is not.
18be45fcc35443aeb33d.id: Isn't adalah bentuk pendek dari is not.

0076945ab91f96255641.en: Don't is short for do not. The apostrophe shows where the o was.
0076945ab91f96255641.id: Don't adalah bentuk pendek dari do not. Tanda apostrof (apostrophe) menunjukkan tempat huruf o tadi.

a321c03e611fe1b99c3f.en: Commas separate the things in a list. The last two are joined with and.
a321c03e611fe1b99c3f.id: Koma (comma) memisahkan benda-benda dalam daftar. Dua yang terakhir disambung dengan and.

36891b5e3c8ad2824b29.en: I am is I'm, is not is isn't, we are is we're and cannot is can't.
36891b5e3c8ad2824b29.id: I am menjadi I'm, is not menjadi isn't, we are menjadi we're, dan cannot menjadi can't.

73e4ad15f554e6d0b11c.en: It is becomes it's. The apostrophe shows the missing i.
73e4ad15f554e6d0b11c.id: It is menjadi it's. Apostrof menunjukkan huruf i yang hilang.

3ce6069413e8d992c43a.en: Commas go between the animals in the list. The last two are joined with and.
3ce6069413e8d992c43a.id: Koma diletakkan di antara nama hewan dalam daftar. Dua yang terakhir disambung dengan and.

6b252eb1c021c97e1e72.en: Don't, isn't and can't come from do not, is not and cannot. I'm, they're and she's come from I am, they are and she is.
6b252eb1c021c97e1e72.id: Don't, isn't, dan can't berasal dari do not, is not, dan cannot. I'm, they're, dan she's berasal dari I am, they are, dan she is.

c125c25f24d4163bf772.en: Didn't is short for did not. The apostrophe takes the place of the o.
c125c25f24d4163bf772.id: Didn't adalah bentuk pendek dari did not. Apostrof menggantikan huruf o.

cb0b1d0b732dd6e8554f.en: We're is short for we are.
cb0b1d0b732dd6e8554f.id: We're adalah bentuk pendek dari we are.

cec299e894fa65c557a7.en: Can't, I'm and wasn't are correct. The other two have the apostrophe in the wrong place.
cec299e894fa65c557a7.id: Can't, I'm, dan wasn't sudah benar. Dua kata lainnya punya apostrof di tempat yang salah.

1660413e1e67fab45af2.en: The list is a hat, a towel, sun cream and a book. Commas go after hat and towel, so we need 2.
1660413e1e67fab45af2.id: Daftarnya adalah a hat, a towel, sun cream and a book. Koma ditulis setelah hat dan towel, jadi kita perlu 2.

ad67ad86aa2af9011d20.en: I will becomes I'll. The apostrophe shows where w and i are missing.
ad67ad86aa2af9011d20.id: I will menjadi I'll. Apostrof menunjukkan tempat huruf w dan i yang hilang.

86936f500c7bad383415.en: I'm is short for I am. The apostrophe goes where the a was.
86936f500c7bad383415.id: I'm adalah bentuk pendek dari I am. Apostrof ditulis di tempat huruf a tadi.

985ba3dda55f1a1accb7.en: Commas go between the names. The last two are joined with and.
985ba3dda55f1a1accb7.id: Koma diletakkan di antara nama-nama itu. Dua nama terakhir disambung dengan and.

ff1f518a86719f844756.en: Its means belonging to it. It's means it is.
ff1f518a86719f844756.id: Its berarti miliknya. It's berarti it is.

b4333f1466231a151325.en: Dogs just means more than one dog, so it has no apostrophe. Don't, isn't and can't need one.
b4333f1466231a151325.id: Dogs hanya berarti lebih dari satu dog, jadi tidak pakai apostrof. Don't, isn't, dan can't perlu apostrof.

24a895e3abe34ccfdb2f.en: Won't is short for will not. It is a special short form.
24a895e3abe34ccfdb2f.id: Won't adalah bentuk pendek dari will not. Ini bentuk pendek yang khusus.

298d83d828fba540b19e.en: The apostrophe shows where letters are missing from cannot.
298d83d828fba540b19e.id: Tanda apostrof (apostrophe) menunjukkan tempat huruf yang hilang dari cannot.

33bbe8583aeeeb8c1e48.en: Don't forget your bag. Don't is the short form of do not.
33bbe8583aeeeb8c1e48.id: Don't forget your bag. Don't adalah bentuk pendek dari do not.

195519e2e47baf477f57.en: Don't is the short form of do not. The apostrophe shows the missing letter o.
195519e2e47baf477f57.id: Don't adalah bentuk pendek dari do not. Apostrof menunjukkan huruf o yang hilang.

af1d954c15c71b1a9b41.en: In a list, we put commas between items and use and before the last one.
af1d954c15c71b1a9b41.id: Dalam sebuah daftar, kita menaruh koma di antara tiap isinya dan memakai and sebelum yang terakhir.

235f3940beec8f70f036.en: Don't is short for do not. The apostrophe takes the place of o.
235f3940beec8f70f036.id: Don't adalah bentuk pendek dari do not. Apostrof menggantikan huruf o.

ffb669554bd06468f4f1.en: It's is short for it is.
ffb669554bd06468f4f1.id: It's adalah bentuk pendek dari it is.

0fb9aac33225a096af1e.id: Can't adalah bentuk pendek dari cannot.

a178e98a14cd4262e575.en: I'm is short for I am.
a178e98a14cd4262e575.id: I'm adalah bentuk pendek dari I am.

336ae8955f3ef30b9ca2.en: She's is short for she is.
336ae8955f3ef30b9ca2.id: She's adalah bentuk pendek dari she is.

175f7418ad4708a14db3.en: Each short form uses an apostrophe.

364313fc8019588933ff.en: Isn't, we're and I'll are short forms.
364313fc8019588933ff.id: Isn't, we're, dan I'll adalah bentuk pendek.

bf400a063e9590b48b0f.en: Don't is the right short form.
bf400a063e9590b48b0f.id: Don't adalah bentuk pendek yang benar.

69c8c9d3fa989d7d6bd6.en: Commas go between items in a list, and and joins the last two.
69c8c9d3fa989d7d6bd6.id: Koma diletakkan di antara isi daftar, dan kata and menyambung dua yang terakhir.

a857b2a5bd982e6f29cf.en: Wouldn't is short for would not.
a857b2a5bd982e6f29cf.id: Wouldn't adalah bentuk pendek dari would not.

c9c2741277eba8f278f9.en: Commas keep the items in a list apart. Example: I have a pen, a ruler and a rubber.
c9c2741277eba8f278f9.id: Koma memisahkan isi sebuah daftar. Contoh: I have a pen, a ruler and a rubber.

70bd40fc565d150a22f5.en: In don't the apostrophe takes the place of the letter o in not. Do not becomes don't.
70bd40fc565d150a22f5.id: Pada don't, apostrof menggantikan huruf o pada not. Do not menjadi don't.

424a805c1374e4f36b04.en: The apostrophe in it's takes the place of the letter i in is. Example: It's a sunny day.
424a805c1374e4f36b04.id: Apostrof pada it's menggantikan huruf i pada is. Contoh: It's a sunny day.

8dbbeba64fb699401fac.en: The apostrophe in I'm takes the place of the letter a in am.
8dbbeba64fb699401fac.id: Apostrof pada I'm menggantikan huruf a pada am.

6876e815d2652f0e2015.en: It's here means it is. It is raining now.
6876e815d2652f0e2015.id: It's di sini berarti it is. It is raining now.

6cba4f75f7c84b74d28e.en: The items in a list are separated by commas, with and before the last item. Example: apples, pears and plums.
6cba4f75f7c84b74d28e.id: Isi sebuah daftar dipisahkan dengan koma, dan ada and sebelum yang terakhir. Contoh: apples, pears and plums.

1b30b32d578dc6892b7c.en: Don't is the short form of do not. The apostrophe takes the place of the o.
1b30b32d578dc6892b7c.id: Don't adalah bentuk pendek dari do not. Apostrof menggantikan huruf o.
